title: D CORE LC-LC OM3 15M Multimode Duplex Fiber Patch Cable

items.h: Connectors: LC Duplex to LC Duplex

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Span longer distances without sacrificing performance with the D CORE LC-LC OM3 Duplex Multimode Fiber Patch Cable. This robust 15-meter (49.2ft) cable is engineered to deliver high-speed, reliable 10Gb/s data transmission across expansive data centers, large server rooms, and complex enterprise network backbones. Featuring precise LC duplex connectors and a durable aqua OM3 fiber, it ensures seamless connectivity over extended runs while maintaining superior signal integrity.


Key Benefits & Features:

Extended Reach for 10G Networks: Perfect for covering longer pathways between racks, rows, or rooms while fully supporting 10 Gigabit Ethernet and other high-speed protocols.

Guaranteed Low Loss Performance: Meticulously manufactured with premium connectors to ensure ultra-low insertion loss (<0.3dB typical), maximizing your optical budget over the extended distance.

Durable & Flexible Design: The flexible OFNR-rated (Riser) jacket withstands the demands of cable trays and conduits, while the booted LC connectors offer excellent strain relief and protection.

Effortless OM3 Identification: The standard aqua blue jacket allows for instant recognition and simplifies cable management in high-density environments.

Plug-and-Play Compatibility: Ready to deploy out of the box for seamless connections between switches, servers, storage area networks (SAN), and other critical network hardware.

Technical Specifications:

  • Product Type: Duplex Fiber Patch Cable
  • Connectors: LC Duplex to LC Duplex
  • Fiber Type: 50/125µm Multimode (OM3)
  • Jacket Color: Aqua
  • Cable Length: 15 Meters (49.2 Feet)
  • Insertion Loss: ≤ 0.3 dB
  • Application: Ideal for 10G Ethernet, Data Center Interconnects, SAN, NAS, and Telecommunication Rooms.
